description: This file defines the RecipesContainerView SwiftUI View component, which displays a list of recipes based on a search query. It interacts with an external AppStore environment object to fetch and display relevant recipes, and updates the store when the view appears.

classes.name: RecipesContainerView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that presents a list of recipes filtered from the application's store based on a search query.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Builds the UI for the View, presenting recipes and handling view appearance behaviors.
